alt: Ruffini (bulbous) corpuscle - slowly-adapting mechanoreceptor in the dermis. Detects skin stretch (joints, finger movement). Spindle-shaped encapsulated ending parallel to the lines of skin tension. (Blausen Medical CC BY 3.0)
